articles.title: Banking groups escalate fight over stablecoin yield ahead of Senate vote
articles.snippet: The American Bankers Association amplified warnings the Senate’s Clarity Act could push deposit flight into stablecoins unless lawmakers tighten yield limits.

articles.title: Crypto and AI could be dirty words on 2026 midterm campaign trail
articles.snippet: Voter attitudes toward the AI and crypto industries aren’t favorable in the US, and a spotlight on how much they’re spending could further alienate them ahead of the 2026 midterms.

articles.title: Bitcoin rallies 2.3% after Trump calls Iran peace proposal ‘totally unacceptable’
articles.snippet: 10x Research CEO Markus Thielen said Bitcoin’s strength above $80,000 could be supported by two favorable decisions in the US Senate this week.

articles.title: OpenAI Just Launched a Consulting Arm to Help Companies Deploy AI
articles.snippet: The OpenAI Deployment Company launches with $4 billion, 19 investors, and a Palantir-style playbook to embed engineers inside enterprises.

articles.title: Crypto Funds Add $858M as Clarity Act Drives Market Optimism
articles.snippet: Digital asset inflows peak at a six-week high as a Senate stablecoin deal stokes institutional appetite across Bitcoin and altcoins.
